Top 10 by excess as exactly 10 rows with an arbitrary tie-break (`LIMIT 10`), ignoring the "including ties" clause.
Top 10 by excess with ties resolved by a secondary sort, such as circuitId ascending.
Top 10 as ranked with dense ranking, so ties at the 10th place are included but the ranks are consecutive, which could include more circuits than rank-based ties.

Counting races as rows per circuitId in races, with no filtering by year or season. Alternatively, the count could be restricted to seasons or races that have results.
queries:
SELECT c.circuitId, c.name, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM races) AS share,
       CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM races) - 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM circuits) AS diff
FROM races r
JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
GROUP BY c.circuitId, c.name
HAVING CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM races) > 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM circuits)
ORDER BY diff DESC
LIMIT 10;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM races WHERE circuitId IS NOT NULL
